expectations.evidence: Recommends building a 'programmatic evaluation API for LMEval' as the single highest-impact thing.
Four-point explanation: 'Unblocks MemoryApi', 'Enables DevPlanner integration', 'Foundation for autonomous refinement loops', 'Every project benefits'. Explicitly states the cascading impact.

Provides TypeScript interface definitions, three specific API endpoints with code examples (POST /api/v1/evaluations/run, GET /:id, GET /:id/results), an implementation sketch with Hono routes, and stretch goals (webhooks, presets, baseline comparison).
PiDog is not mentioned as a priority. Only appears in passing under 'Every project benefits' as one of many consumers.
